project.name: Reaper
project.summary: Flow-first programming language with a Python reference runtime, developing native C17 core and explicit tooling integrations in a four-project desktop federation.

capabilities.summary: Reference lexer, parser, AST interpreter, CLI and bounded execution semantics.
Selectable Python bytecode VM over Canonical IR while tree-walk execution remains the compatibility default.
Versioned .rpr module loading, isolated scopes, cached exports, dependency graph and cycle diagnostics.
Managed resource accounting, heap and open-file quotas, deterministic cleanup and execution limits.
Consumes versioned OPlague device snapshots and exposes normalized comparison reporting.
Optional typed bridge to Pytyliki C ABI v1; native loading is explicitly gated by the caller.
Creates and inspects reference MCU projects and cross-builds with user-installed toolchains; no built-in flashing or live hardware debugging is claimed.
Reaper-written tokenizer and Pratt expression parser cover a tested subset, not a complete self-hosting compiler.
Repeatedly squares an explicit deterministic transformation pipeline by applying the same pass sequence 2^depth times.
Validates the complete four-project directed peer product, twelve status-labelled links, eight pyramid facets and four independent self-loops without a central runtime dependency.
Native C17 catalog of 66 stable architecture concepts across nine layers, with exact lookup, bounded graph validation and deterministic dependency-first ordering.

Exported Reaper system-function module provides deterministic contract-graph preflight, bounded tracked regions and cooperative worker budgets, atomic diff/reconcile plans, ephemeral byte-buffer comparison, guarded revisions, lease checks, local p95/p99 profiling, local-only effect preflight and migration rollback fixtures in the Python reference runtime; compile-time/type-level and native C17 parity remain incomplete.

interfaces.format: OCTA-8 octagonal-pyramid topology and peer contract
Versioned .rpr module with JSON-compatible records and explicit callback contracts

integrations.summary: Reads a caller-selected OPlague snapshot and validates its declared schema before comparison.
Uses an explicitly enabled native bridge and trusted shared-library path for metric cross-checks.
Participates in the direct OCTA-8 peer mesh; OPlague publishes device snapshots and validates Reaper comparison reports.
Participates in the OCTA-8 peer mesh through explicit synchronous Pytyliki ABI request/response.
Records membership in the shared four-project OCTA-8 topology without introducing a runtime dependency.

safety_boundaries: Execution quotas are resource guardrails, not a security sandbox for untrusted programs.
Filesystem, process, network, clock, shell and native-library effects remain explicit or opt-in rather than ambient expression behavior.
Native FFI executes in-process native code and must only load trusted ABI-compatible libraries.
The native C17 implementation and self-hosting frontend remain partial; Python is the compatibility reference.
The architecture foundation registry validates metadata and declared dependency graphs only; it does not load code, start runtimes, isolate containers or grant hardware privileges.
The system-functions v1 worker quota is cooperative in the Python reference runtime; it is not OS-enforced process isolation or a hard process-RSS limit.
The arena-slot API limits tracked reference-runtime allocations and rejects escaped region allocations; it is not a zero-allocation host arena.
Ephemeral comparison overwrites only its owned mutable working buffers and cannot erase caller-owned or immutable copies.
Contract graph, lease, local-only and rollback checks are runtime preflight functions until the native compiler gains compile-time evaluation, type-level leases and effect-checked module headers.
extension_points: Canonical IR and selectable execution engines.
Versioned .rpr module interfaces and explicit import/export boundaries.
Opt-in C ABI adapters and validated versioned JSON interchange.
Native C17 frontend stages with Python reference behavior as the compatibility oracle.
Bounded vertical self-composition for deterministic compiler and data-flow transformation pipelines.
Stable architecture concept IDs, layer metadata and bounded dependency graph validation.
Explicit stdlib/system.rpr APIs for bounded system operations, revision guards, local telemetry and reversible migration preflight.
